title: Building a GTA clone over WhatsApp
author: friedbeef
selftext:
Hi folks, I'm super happy to share that I've almost finished with my GTA clone. I challenged myself to build it all over Instinct (Mainly WhatsApp with a few Slack messages thrown in). 

The game, the trailer video, the user feedbsck collection, the launch signup page.  Come join me on this journey. Yes it will be released for free :) 

https://jth.anyinkling.com/ come come sign up to be notified about the launch.. 

You can also go to https://jth-controls-test.pages.dev/tests/  to Playtest some concepts and leave your feedback.

If all goes well, I'll have a Multiplayer deathmatch GTA clone soon. So stoked that so much can be done with just a phone in today's world of game development :)
